Water Leak and Water Damage Repairs
Caravan Leak Repairs Before the Damage Gets Worse

A small leak can cause significant damage if water continues to enter your caravan. Moisture around windows, roof joins, seals and external fittings can affect wall linings, flooring, cabinetry and other internal components.

Our team can assess signs of water ingress, investigate the affected areas and recommend the repairs needed. Depending on the extent of the damage, the work may involve sealing leaks, replacing damaged materials or repairing affected structural components.
If you have noticed damp smells, soft flooring, staining or bubbling wall linings, it is worth getting the problem checked before it spreads.
